title: Investigate populateLessonBlocks migration failures
body: The populateLessonBlocks migration is failing for 106 lessons in production. The error is swallowed in a catch block without logging the actual error. Need to add proper error logging to understand why these lessons fail.
rationale: These 106 lessons may be the ones causing the 'nearly empty' page issue when their blocks are not properly backfilled.

title: Check visibleRenderers edge case
body: If visibleRenderers is set to an empty array [], getVisibleTabs returns all tabs hidden, causing DualModeLessonView to render nothing. This edge case should be handled defensively.
rationale: This could explain the 'nearly empty' page - all tabs would be hidden but the page structure would still render.

title: Add E2E test for lesson page rendering
body: The integration test only tests queryLessonBlocks directly. Need an E2E test that navigates to a lesson page and verifies content renders.
rationale: The current test doesn't catch rendering issues in DualModeLessonView, LessonPager, or AccessGateProvider.
